Rae - CS: Mercury Analytics requests a 3-day focused enablement (AM sessions, UTC-2). Priority: Dedicated migration, throughput SLOs, and renewals check. Current account health: yellow (usage plateau + two open infra tickets).
Tom - CSM: They prefer short hands-on blocks and one executive show-and-tell on final day. Can presenters confirm availability?
Priya - Enablement: I can lead Day 1 (platform + auth + deploy patterns) and Day 3 (adoption + exec sync). Who wants Day 2 perf deep-dive?
Ilan - SE: I'll take Day 2 (batching, KV cache, quantization) and run the performance lab. I can also prepare a quick diagnostic notebook for attendees.
Rae - CS: Please include a renewal signal checkpoint at the end of Day 3 (10m). We'll capture adoption metrics and any blockers.
Priya - Enablement: Draft agenda:
Day 1 (2.5h): intro + customer pre-read recap (15m) / auth & sample deploy (45m) / lab: pin-and-run (60m) / Q&A & actions (30m)
Day 2 (2.5h): perf strategies (30m) / live labs: batching & cache (90m) / troubleshooting runbook (20m) / Q&A (10m)
Day 3 (2h): dedicated deployment patterns (40m) / monitoring & SLOs (35m) / adoption review + renewal checkpoint (10m) / exec show-and-tell (35m)
Ops Bot: Pre-flight checklist reminder set: pre-read to customer 72h before Day 1, health-check script run 48h prior.
Ilan - SE: Health-check snippet I'll provide:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/customers/mercury/health | jq .metrics
```
Tom - CSM: Also request Maz (VP Customer) on Day 3 exec block. I'll send calendar invite once agenda final.
Priya - Enablement: Feedback plan: 1 short form after each day + ephemeral Slack poll at session end (confidence + blockers). I'll seed pre-read with the form link.
Rae - CS: Risk notes: two infra tickets around GPU preemption and an embedding error spike last week. @Ilan can you add a mini-fix session in Day 2 lab if the health-check shows errors?
Ilan - SE: Yes 1. Will include "embedding retry policy" and sample curl checks in the lab repo.
Tom - CSM: Timeline: finalize agenda by EOD Wed (1769999120), invites Fri, pre-read 72h before Day 1. Presenters ack?
Priya - Enablement: ack :white_check_mark:
Ilan - SE: ack :white_check_mark:
Rae - CS: I'll update the renewal tracker and flag any action items. Thanks team! :sparkles:
